method: Per-programme official fee pages on study.ed.ac.uk (degree finder "Tuition fees" page, programme_code=<code>&year=2027), whose table is rendered client-side and was read in a browser pane; programme codes taken from each course page link. Cross-checked against the Registry Services "Full-time fees for new students 2027-2028" table (registryservices.ed.ac.uk) which shows identical figures for the programme codes checked, and the study.ed.ac.uk England/Wales/NI/RoI fees page. Observation: the Registry page boilerplate says "only apply if you are entering study in 2026-2027" although its title and intro are 2027-2028 and its figures match the degree-finder 2027/8 rows (a wording error on that page; figures not in conflict). The degree-finder page says the RUK rate "increased in November 2026" whereas the other pages say the cap was announced November 2025 (wording inconsistency only; figure is the same £10,050 everywhere).

universityWideStatements.quote: If you are starting or continuing your studies in 2027, the fee for the 2027-28 academic year will be £10,050.
universityWideStatements.title: England, Wales, Northern Ireland and Republic of Ireland tuition fees and costs | Undergraduate study | The University of Edinburgh
universityWideStatements.appliesTo: Rest of UK (RUK) rate, which the page says covers England, Wales, Northern Ireland, Republic of Ireland and the Channel Islands; "the annual RUK tuition fee for all full-time undergraduate degree programmes except for the BVM&S Veterinary Medicine (Graduate Entry Programme - 4-year programme)". Annual (per-year) fee, not a capped total. Per-course figures were still read from each course fee page.
